items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. TLS evidence reports no certificate expiring within 30 days, but this is not proof of complete TLS safety. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private and parked launch gates, block security-sensitive releases and public exposure, and permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix; do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work or requeue unchanged work.
